findings: `overflow-hidden` / `overflow-y-auto` conflict — The section element has both Tailwind classes. `overflow-hidden` compiles to `overflow: hidden`, setting `overflow-y: hidden`. `overflow-y: auto` only wins if Tailwind emits that rule later in the generated stylesheet, which is not guaranteed. If `overflow-hidden` wins, the section clips content at 100vh with no scroll affordance, making FAQ items below the fold inaccessible on shorter screens. Fix: replace `overflow-hidden` with `overflow-x-hidden` to set axes independently.
